units.source_text: 他们三人乘上龙助店里的车子，向北野六番町的甲鱼铺所在地大市奔去。

en.t: The three of them got into the car from Ryusuke's shop and hurried toward Daichi, the turtle restaurant in Kitano Rokubancho.

units.source_text: 大市是一家格局古雅的老铺子，旅客尽人皆知。

en.t: Daichi was an old, elegantly arranged establishment, known to virtually every traveler.

units.source_text: 房子破旧，天花板也很低矮。

en.t: The building was worn and shabby, and the ceiling was very low as well.
